sequence.subject: A disclosed sponsorship option on GLP Clinic Scout
sequence.body:
Hi {organization} team,

I'm Izaiah, the publisher of GLP Clinic Scout. We help readers compare GLP-1 providers. We're an independent comparison publisher, not a clinic.

Would a clearly labeled sponsorship be useful to your team? Our proposed first 30-day pilot is $200, including setup, a Sponsored panel above the directory results, a separate paid promo page and an aggregate delivery report. A same-scope 30-day renewal would be $100, only if you choose to renew. No automatic renewal.

The value is a separate place to explain your offer to readers already comparing provider options, with your approved wording and link. Sponsored placements never change our independent rankings. This is an early pilot, not a promise of scale. We do not have a reliable panel-impression forecast and cannot guarantee traffic, leads or sales.

I've attached the proposed pricing card, the placement mockup and the paid-page example. The preview uses placeholders, not approved provider claims. Before anything goes live, we'd agree on the exact URL, creative, program permissions and dates. No space or start date is reserved by this email.

If it looks relevant, reply with the person who handles partnerships and we can confirm the scope. After a reviewed order and readiness checks, sponsorship payments would go to PayPal ops@glpclinicscout.com. Please don't send payment before we confirm the order.

sequence.subject: Following up on the GLP Clinic Scout sponsorship proposal
sequence.body:
Hi {organization} team,

A quick follow-up on the proposed GLP Clinic Scout sponsorship. The first 30 days would be $200, including setup, a labeled directory panel, a separate promo page and an aggregate delivery report. A same-scope renewal would be $100, with no automatic renewal.

The attached card and mockups show the format. Paid inventory stays separate from our independent rankings. We cannot promise impressions, leads or sales. Your exact wording, link and program permission would need review before launch.

Is there someone on your team who handles this kind of partnership? Any reply will pause these follow-ups. Payment, after an agreed order and readiness checks, would be by PayPal to ops@glpclinicscout.com. Nothing is booked or payable yet.

sequence.subject: Last note about the GLP Clinic Scout sponsor pilot
sequence.body:
Hi {organization} team,

This is my last follow-up about the proposed sponsorship on GLP Clinic Scout. The attached examples show the labeled directory panel and separate paid promo page. The proposed price is $200 for the first 30 days and $100 for an optional same-scope renewal. Sponsored placements never change our independent rankings, and there is no traffic or sales guarantee.

If you'd like to explore it, reply and we'll confirm the exact scope, creative permissions and dates. PayPal remittance would be to ops@glpclinicscout.com only after a reviewed order and readiness checks.

If it's not a fit, no action is needed. We won't send another message in this sequence. You can also reply STOP or unsubscribe to opt out of future outreach.
